definitions.N: normalized root input_size_units fixed for the whole run
definitions.S: a nonterminal canonical residual reachable under the fixed deterministic theorem-mode algorithm
definitions.R: the set of currently live original root variables
definitions.G_elim(S): canonical live-pivot list tested by first_capped_elimination
definitions.G_v2(S): all nondegenerate sign-aware literal pairs co-occurring in S, enumerated in frozen canonical order by v2
definitions.SAFE_elim(S,x): exact eliminate_var_capped(S,x,N^2) returns a CNF and exact replay verifies it
definitions.SAFE_v2(S,a,b): the frozen exact B2 pair macro for (a,b), followed atomically by a roots_only exact capped elimination, is admitted and strictly decreases frozen progress phi

already_proved_polynomial_grammar_size.v2_pair_types: |G_v2(S)| <= 4*binom(n,2) = 2*n*(n-1) = O(N^2), because retained live-variable count never exceeds the original n<=N
already_proved_polynomial_grammar_size.consequence: The root-phase candidate grammar itself is polynomial-size. The missing theorem is availability/totality, not enumeration size.

main_candidate.statement: For every reachable nonterminal root-phase state S of the fixed algorithm after the exact terminal portfolio has declined to decide, either there exists x in G_elim(S) with SAFE_elim(S,x), or there exists (a,b) in G_v2(S) with SAFE_v2(S,a,b).
main_candidate.equivalent_failure_witness: A reachable root-phase state at the ordinary-elimination call site for which every canonical ordinary pivot overflows the fixed N^2 raw cap and frozen exhaustive v2 returns no exact strict-progress root rescue.

strong_counting_subcandidate.statement: Every reachable root-phase state S with all ordinary pivots overflowing N^2 has max sign-aware literal-pair cooccurrence t_max >= s-2N+11.
strong_counting_subcandidate.why_useful: Together with the already proved FREQUENT_PAIR_FORCES_V2_ROOT_RESCUE lemma, L1A would imply L1 in the all-pivot-overflow region.

weaker_density_subcandidate.statement: Every reachable root-phase all-pivot-overflow state satisfies P >= 2*n*(n-1)*(s-2N+11), where P=sum_C binom(|C|,2).

known_reductions.low_volume: If s<=N, every live pivot fits N^2; therefore L1 is automatic there.
known_reductions.frequent_pair: If t_max>=s-2N+11, frozen v2 rescue is guaranteed.
known_reductions.pair_density: If P>=2*n*(n-1)*(s-2N+11), the frequent-pair condition follows by pigeonhole and v2 rescue is guaranteed.
known_reductions.unresolved_region: roots live AND all ordinary pivots overflow N^2 AND the sufficient frequent-pair/density conditions do not trigger.

falsification_protocol.rule: A state that is not reachable under the fixed deterministic theorem core cannot refute L1.
procedure: Generate hostile canonical root CNFs without using SAT truth labels in selection.
Instrument only the ordinary-elimination and v2 discovery call sites without changing their return values.
Freeze every reachable root-phase state where ordinary elimination returns None.
Measure t_max and P exactly on that frozen state.
Run the unmodified frozen v2 discovery on the same state.
If v2 also returns None, freeze the source CNF, state CNF, event prefix and exact measurements as an L1 counterexample.
If t_max<s-2N+11, reject L1A even when v2 succeeds by another mechanism.
If P<2*n*(n-1)*(s-2N+11), reject L1B even when v2 succeeds.
Absence of a bounded counterexample never promotes L1/L1A/L1B to a theorem.

proof_obligations_if_L1_survives: Give a symbolic existence proof for at least one exact ordinary or v2 grammar move on every reachable root-phase state.
Show deterministic discovery and exact verification work remain polynomial in original N, including failed grammar candidates.
Compose L1 with the already proved O(N) outer-transition bound and PIRC input-relative envelope bridge.
Separately close the root-free v3 tail; L1 alone is insufficient for P2 universal preservation.
